intentComment: Story 103 (sprint Balancexit, docs/BalancerWinddownPlan.md section 4 Stage 2) - MAINNET index-4 cutover BalancerPoolerV2 0x7f6874332c4629429d70D15f685A8230323F11F1 -> a new UniPoolerV2 on the phUSD/sUSDS Uniswap V2 pair, ONE owner broadcast session (script/DeployMainnetUniPoolerCutover.s.sol on script/helpers/UniPoolerCutoverCore.sol; full detail in its NatSpec). NO PROTOCOL FUNDS THROUGH ANY EOA (yield-claim-nft:052): BPT, sUSDS, phUSD and USDS move contract-to-contract through UniPoolerCutoverEscrow (operator = OWNER); the core require()s after every step that OWNER's balances did not rise; owner BPT is out of scope and only reported (F-02-052). PRECONDITIONS require()d on chain: story 099's revoke (all four poolers unauthorized on the old pooler) and the pair absent or reserve-less. INPUTS: RECOVERY_EXIT=true selects removeLiquidityRecovery (pool paused + Recovery Mode, after 30 Oct; default false = removeLiquidityProportional). MIN_SUSDS_OUT_WEI and MIN_PHUSD_OUT_WEI are REQUIRED and non-zero: quote them off-chain with  eval "$(node scripts/quote-balancer-exit-min-amounts.js 10)"  (cast call share of the old pooler's BPT minus a 1..50 bps tolerance; the core re-checks each floor against the live share), in the SAME shell before :preview and :broadcast so both use identical floors. :preview = fork simulation as OWNER (PREVIEW_MODE=true, nothing signed, progress NOT written) plus a preview-only test mint at index 4 and a quotePool-floored pool(). :broadcast = backup mainnet-addresses.ts, Ledger m/44'/60'/46'/0/0 (gas price CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI, default 0.3 gwei), writes server/deployments/progress.unipooler-cutover.1.json, then the mandatory && tail patch-mainnet-addresses-unipooler-cutover.js (fills ONLY the UniPooler and PhusdSusdsPair zero placeholders, never BalancerPooler) && :verify && :preview (a no-op once the progress file is completed and live). NOT prefixed with the preview. A CRASH MID-BROADCAST POISONS THE PROGRESS FILE: resume from broadcast receipts, not the progress file, and rename it to progress.unipooler-cutover.1.POISONED.<ts>.bak. Never call setPool on the old pooler while an escrow pointing at it is live (L-27). :verify = read-only script/VerifyUniPoolerCutover.s.sol (configs(4)/hook on UniPooler, pair reserves == seed, LP on UniPooler, old pooler paused and empty, escrow residuals and owner BPT reported as warnings only, quotePool-floored pool() simulated). Kill switch afterwards: UniPoolerV2.incrementAuthVersion() stops pool() without touching mints.
intentSummary: Story 103 (Balancexit, BalancerWinddownPlan §4 Stage 2): one owner broadcast session that cuts NFTMinterV2 index 4 over from BalancerPoolerV2 0x7f68…11F1 to a freshly deployed UniPoolerV2 on a newly created canonical phUSD/sUSDS UniV2 pair, moving BPT/sUSDS/phUSD/USDS contract-to-contract through a one-shot UniPoolerCutoverEscrow (yield-claim-nft:052), then retiring (setMinter(OWNER)+pause) the old pooler.

preview.envProvisioning: eval "$(node scripts/quote-balancer-exit-min-amounts.js 10)" in the same shell before :preview (not chained in the npm key)
preview.notes: OWNER vm.startPrank, no progress file written; runs _previewEndToEnd (deal + test mint at index 4 + quotePool-floored pool() in a reverted snapshot). Refuses to run if a non-completed progress file exists.

broadcast.command: node scripts/backup-mainnet-addresses.js && export CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI=${CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI:-300000000} && forge script script/DeployMainnetUniPoolerCutover.s.sol:DeployMainnetUniPoolerCutover --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --sender 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6 --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price $CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-unipooler-cutover.js && npm run unipooler-cutover:verify && npm run unipooler-cutover:preview
broadcast.notes: NOT prefixed with :preview. Chain: backup -> forge broadcast -> patcher -> :verify -> :preview (preview is a no-op once progress is completed and UniPooler live at index 4). DO NOT RUN.

verify.notes: Read-only; requires progress.unipooler-cutover.1.json (completed); simulated pool() in reverted snapshot. Fails pre-broadcast by design ('no progress file').

tests: test/VerifyUniPoolerCutoverGuards.t.sol (pins npm keys/order + helper presence, reads package.json)
